AccountCreate.description:
``POST /accounts``.

``currency`` defaults to the household's base currency; ``is_asset`` and
``manual_balance`` default from ``type``. ``asset_kind`` is required for
(and only for) ``manual_asset``. ``opening_balance`` records a manual
balance snapshot on ``opening_balance_date`` (default ``opened_on``, else
today); its currency must be the account's.
AccountCreate.title: AccountCreate

AccountUpdate.description:
``PATCH /accounts/{id}``: only the fields given change.

``null`` clears ``nickname``, ``institution_id``, ``number_last4`` and
``opened_on``. Changing ``type`` resets ``is_asset``/``manual_balance`` to
the new type's defaults unless they are given too. ``currency`` can only
change while the account has no transactions, balances or schedules.
Closing and reopening have their own endpoints.
AccountUpdate.title: AccountUpdate

AdminUserCreate.description: ``POST /admin/users``: a local account with no household and no admin flag.
AdminUserCreate.title: AdminUserCreate

AdminUserUpdate.description:
``PATCH /admin/users/{id}``: activation, break-glass and email-verified flags.

``is_instance_admin`` is deliberately not accepted (``extra="forbid"``).
AdminUserUpdate.title: AdminUserUpdate

ApplyMapping.description:
``POST /imports/{document_id}/apply-mapping``.

``mapping_id`` (CSV/TSV) names the mapping to read the table with (else
the one whose fingerprint matches); ``account_id`` names the account to
import into (else the document's, the mapping's or, for OFX/QFX/QIF, the
account matched by its last four digits). The caller must be able to
edit the target account.
ApplyMapping.title: ApplyMapping

AssetKind.description: Kind of a ``manual_asset`` account (NULL for every other type).
AssetKind.title: AssetKind

AutoPairRequest.description:
Pair unlinked transfers among the accounts the caller may edit.

``account_ids`` narrows the accounts (all editable ones by default);
``date_from``/``date_to`` bound the posted dates; ``window_days`` is how
far apart the two legs' dates may be.
AutoPairRequest.title: AutoPairRequest

BudgetCreate.description:
``POST /budgets``.

``period`` monthly or annual: ``start_date`` is the first day of a month
and there is no ``end_date``; periods are calendar months, or twelve
months from ``start_date``. ``custom``: one period ``start_date ..
end_date`` (at most 3660 days). ``currency`` defaults to the household's
base currency.
BudgetCreate.title: BudgetCreate

BudgetLineIn.description: The amount per period for one category (``>= 0``, the budget's currency).
BudgetLineIn.title: BudgetLineIn

BudgetReportLine.description:
One budget line in one period.

``budgeted`` is the line amount; ``carried_over`` what rollover brings
from earlier periods (expense lines of a ``rollover`` budget only);
``available = budgeted + carried_over``; ``actual`` the money spent
(expense) or received (income) in the period; ``remaining = available -
actual``; ``forecast`` the expected actual at the end of the period.
BudgetReportLine.title: BudgetReportLine

BudgetUpdate.description:
``PATCH /budgets/{id}``: absent fields stay; ``lines`` replaces the whole set.

Changing ``currency`` needs ``lines`` in the same request (their amounts
are in the new currency).
BudgetUpdate.title: BudgetUpdate

BulkAction.title: BulkAction

CashflowReport.description: ``GET /reports/cashflow``: money in, money out (positive) and net per month.
CashflowReport.title: CashflowReport

CategoryCreate.description:
``POST /categories``.

A child takes its parent's ``kind`` (giving another one is a ``422``); a
top-level category defaults to ``expense``.
CategoryCreate.title: CategoryCreate

CategoryUpdate.description:
``PATCH /categories/{id}``: rename, move (``parent_id``), kind, tax treatment.

Moving under another parent makes the category and its descendants take
that parent's kind; changing a top-level category's kind changes its
descendants too.
CategoryUpdate.title: CategoryUpdate

ContributionCreate.description:
``POST /goals/{id}/contributions``.

Either ``amount`` (in the goal's currency), or ``transaction_id`` (a
transaction on one of the goal's accounts; its amount converted into the
goal's currency on its posted date is the default amount, its posted
date the default ``contributed_on``), or both. ``contributed_on``
defaults to today and may not be in the future.
ContributionCreate.title: ContributionCreate

DocumentDetailOut.description:
``GET /documents/{id}``: metadata only (never the file or extracted text).

``downloadable`` says whether ``GET /documents/{id}/download`` would
serve the caller (not quarantined, and member or above, or a viewer in a
household that allows viewer downloads); ``can_edit`` whether the caller
may reprocess, link or delete it.
DocumentDetailOut.title: DocumentDetailOut

DocumentLinkIn.description:
``POST /documents/{id}/link``: attach the document to a transaction or account.

Investment transactions, loan payments and tax years arrive with their
phases (``422 link-target-unsupported`` until then).
DocumentLinkIn.title: DocumentLinkIn

DocumentOut.description: A document as the API shows it (no blob location or key material).
DocumentOut.title: DocumentOut

DocumentPage.description: ``GET /documents``: newest first; ``next_cursor`` is ``null`` on the last page.
DocumentPage.title: DocumentPage

DocumentReceivedOut.description:
``POST /documents`` (``202``): the file is stored; ingestion runs in the worker.

``job_id`` is the ``ingest_document`` job (``GET /jobs/{id}``); it is
``null`` when the content is already in the household (``duplicate_of``)
and the document waits in the review queue instead.
DocumentReceivedOut.title: DocumentReceivedOut

ExportOut.description: An export job of the caller; ``counts`` per entity once ``ready``.
ExportOut.title: ExportOut

ExportRequest.description: ``POST /export``: an optional passphrase to encrypt the archive with (G3).
ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest

FlowReport.description:
``GET /reports/spending`` and ``GET /reports/income``.

Spending amounts are positive money out (refunds in an expense category
reduce them); income amounts are positive money in.
FlowReport.title: FlowReport

GoalProgressOut.description:
Progress as of ``as_of`` (``app.domain.goals.progress``).

``accounts_balance`` is the balance of the goal's accounts today in the
goal's currency (``null`` without accounts or when a rate is missing).
GoalProgressOut.title: GoalProgressOut

GoalUpdate.description: ``PATCH /goals/{id}``: absent fields stay; ``account_ids`` replaces the set.
GoalUpdate.title: GoalUpdate

HouseholdUpdate.description: ``PATCH /households/{id}``: only these two fields can change.
HouseholdUpdate.title: HouseholdUpdate

ImportOut.description: An import job of the caller: created/merged/skipped counts, or why it failed.
ImportOut.title: ImportOut

ImportPreview.description: ``GET /imports/{document_id}/preview``: the stored sandbox output, never re-parsed.
ImportPreview.title: ImportPreview

JobOut.description:
A job's progress through its life cycle.

``finished`` is true once the job will not run again on its own
(``succeeded``, ``failed`` or ``dead``). The payload and the last error
are never returned (they are for operators, not for API callers).
JobOut.title: JobOut

JobState.description:
Life cycle of a job row.

* ``queued``: waiting; eligible once ``run_after <= now()``.
* ``running``: leased by ``locked_by`` until ``lease_expires_at``; the
  reaper returns expired leases to ``queued`` (or ``dead``).
* ``succeeded``: finished.
* ``failed``: the last attempt failed and the job is not runnable as is
  (terminal unless re-queued explicitly).
* ``dead``: dead-lettered (``max_attempts`` exhausted or non-retryable).
JobState.title: JobState

ManualBalanceIn.description:
``POST /accounts/{id}/balances``: the balance at the end of ``as_of_date``.

Replaces an earlier manual balance of the same date. The currency must be
the account's.
ManualBalanceIn.title: ManualBalanceIn

MappingCreate.description:
``POST /imports/mappings``.

The header fingerprint comes from ``document_id`` (the server reads the
header row ``spec.skip_rows`` of the document's extracted table) or is
given as ``header_fingerprint``; exactly one of the two.
MappingCreate.title: MappingCreate

MappingSpec.description: How to read one delimited layout (module doc).
MappingSpec.title: MappingSpec

MappingUpdate.description:
``PATCH /imports/mappings/{id}``: only the named fields change.

``null`` clears ``account_id`` / ``institution_id``; ``document_id`` (or
``header_fingerprint``) recomputes (sets) the fingerprint.
MappingUpdate.title: MappingUpdate

Money.description: Money in a response body; build with :meth:`of`.
Money.title: Money

NewLocalUser.description: A local account created for an invited member (or by an instance admin).
NewLocalUser.title: NewLocalUser

PayeeCreate.description: ``POST /payees``: a canonical name, the statement spellings that mean it, a default.
PayeeCreate.title: PayeeCreate

Reference.description:
The name of a referenced object, so an export can be imported elsewhere.

Categories are named by their path (``"Food / Groceries"``).
Reference.title: Reference

ReportItem.description:
One group: ``key`` is a category, payee or account id, or ``YYYY-MM``.

``key`` is ``null`` for uncategorised lines (``group_by=category``) and
lines without a payee (``group_by=payee``); ``name`` is the category,
payee or account name (``null`` for a month or a missing one).
ReportItem.title: ReportItem

ReviewItemOut.description:
One review item. ``payload`` carries ids and short facts, never file content.

``next_step`` names what the UI should offer; ``can_resolve`` whether the
caller may resolve or dismiss it.
ReviewItemOut.title: ReviewItemOut

ReviewPage.description: Oldest first (a queue); ``next_cursor`` is ``null`` on the last page.
ReviewPage.title: ReviewPage

RuleApply.description: Re-run the enabled rules (or the enabled ones among ``rule_ids``) as a job.
RuleApply.title: RuleApply

RuleBody.description: What a rule does: shared by create, import and the inline dry run.
RuleBody.title: RuleBody

RuleCreate.description: A new rule; it is appended after the existing ones (reorder to move it).
RuleCreate.title: RuleCreate

RuleDiff.description: What applying the rules would change (fields that stay the same are ``null``).
RuleDiff.title: RuleDiff

RuleExportItem-Input.description: One rule of an export document (no ids, no statistics).
RuleExportItem-Input.title: RuleExportItem

RuleExportItem-Output.description: One rule of an export document (no ids, no statistics).
RuleExportItem-Output.title: RuleExportItem

RuleImport.description:
An export document plus how to combine it with the existing rules.

``append`` adds the rules after the existing ones; ``replace`` deletes
the existing rules first. Every id is kept when it names an object of
this household, else resolved by its name in ``references`` (``422
rule-reference-unresolved`` when that fails).
RuleImport.title: RuleImport

RuleList.description: All rules of the household in evaluation order (at most :data:`RULES_MAX`).
RuleList.title: RuleList

RuleOut.description: A rule. ``redacted``: accounts the reader cannot see show as the nil UUID.
RuleOut.title: RuleOut

RuleReorder.description: Every rule id of the household, in the new evaluation order.
RuleReorder.title: RuleReorder

RuleTest.description:
Dry run against history; nothing is written.

``rule_id`` tests one saved rule on its own (also a disabled one),
``rule`` an unsaved one; neither runs the household's enabled rules in
order, exactly as ``POST /rules/apply`` would.
RuleTest.title: RuleTest

RuleTestResult.description:
One page of matches; continue with ``next_cursor`` (``null``: history exhausted).

``scanned`` counts the transactions examined for this page (at most
``app.domain.rules.service.TEST_SCAN_MAX``), ``matched`` the items.
RuleTestResult.title: RuleTestResult

RuleUpdate.description: Change any of the fields; ``null`` is not a value for any of them.
RuleUpdate.title: RuleUpdate

SplitAmountLine-Input.description: ``amount`` is a positive magnitude; ``null`` takes the remainder.
SplitAmountLine-Input.title: SplitAmountLine

SplitAmountLine-Output.description: ``amount`` is a positive magnitude; ``null`` takes the remainder.
SplitAmountLine-Output.title: SplitAmountLine

SplitSet.description:
Replace a transaction's splits.

``splits`` is empty (remove the splits; the transaction is uncategorised
unless ``category_id`` is given) or holds at least two lines whose amounts,
in the transaction's currency, add up exactly to the transaction amount.
SplitSet.title: SplitSet

TaxTreatment.description: Hint for the tax vault; NULL means not tax relevant / unknown.
TaxTreatment.title: TaxTreatment

token.description: The raw token. Shown once; it cannot be retrieved again.
token.title: Token

TransactionCreate.description: A manual transaction. ``amount.currency`` must be the account's currency.
TransactionCreate.title: TransactionCreate

TransactionUpdate.description:
Fields to change; an absent field is left alone, ``null`` clears it.

The account and currency of a transaction never change (delete and
re-create instead). ``tag_ids`` replaces the whole tag set.
TransactionUpdate.title: TransactionUpdate

TransferLink.description: Pair the path transaction with ``counterpart_id`` as one transfer.
TransferLink.title: TransferLink

TransferOut.description:
The transfer a transaction belongs to.

``counterpart_id`` is the other leg when the caller may see its account,
else ``null`` (the transfer exists, the hidden account is not revealed).
TransferOut.title: TransferOut

TrendRow.description: One category (or the total): this month against last month and a year ago.
TrendRow.title: TrendRow

UnbudgetedOut.description: Spending in a category without a line (``null``: uncategorised).
UnbudgetedOut.title: UnbudgetedOut
